keys.ff.arc: :arc: [accent]Arc[] turrets require power to function. Research and place an :arc: [accent]Arc[] turret near a power node.
keys.ff.battery: :battery: [accent]Batteries[] store power.\nResearch and place a :battery: [accent]Battery[] close to the node.
keys.ff.coalpower: Input :coal: coal into the generator to produce [accent]:power: power[].
keys.ff.craft: Move :coal: coal into the :graphite-press: [accent]Graphite Press[].\nIt will output :graphite: graphite to all nearby conveyors.\nMove the output :graphite: graphite from the :graphite-press: [accent]Graphite Press[] into the core.
keys.ff.generator: :coal: Coal can also be used as fuel in :combustion-generator: [accent]Combustion Generators[].\nResearch and place a :combustion-generator: [accent]Combustion Generator[].
keys.ff.node: :power-node: [accent]Power Nodes[] transmit power to nearby blocks in range.\nResearch and place a :power-node: [accent]Power Node[] close to the generator.
keys.filters.empty: [lightgray]No filters! Add one with the button below.
keys.frontier.tutorial1:
The :additive-reconstructor: [accent]Additive Reconstructor[]
upgrades tier 1 units to tier 2
using :silicon: silicon and :graphite: graphite.

[accent]Reconstruct a []:dagger:[accent] dagger
to a []:mace:[accent] mace.
keys.frontier.tutorial2: Enemy waves send [accent]infinitely[] until all enemy cores are [unlaunched]destroyed.
keys.frontier.tutorial3: [accent]Attack the enemy base fast to prevent waves from getting too high[].
keys.fungalpass.tutorial1: Use [accent]units[] to defend buildings and attack the enemy.\nResearch and place a :ground-factory: [accent]ground factory[].
keys.fungalpass.tutorial2: Select :dagger: [accent]Dagger[] units in the factory.\nProduce 3 units.
keys.graphicstype.clear: Fill the display with a color.
keys.graphicstype.col: Equivalent to color, but packed.\nPacked colors are written as hex codes with a [accent]%[] prefix.\nExample: [accent]%ff0000[] would be red.
keys.graphicstype.color: Set color for next drawing operations.
keys.graphicstype.image: Draw an image of some content or copies another display.\nex content: [accent]@router[], [accent]@dagger[] or a display [accent]display1[].
keys.graphicstype.print: Draws text from the print buffer.\nOnly ASCII characters are allowed.\nClears the print buffer.
keys.gz.aa: Flying units cannot easily be dispatched with standard turrets.\n:scatter: [accent]Scatter[] turrets provide excellent anti-air, but require :lead: [accent]lead[] as ammo.
keys.gz.conveyors:
Research and place :conveyor: [accent]conveyors[] to move the mined resources
from drills to the core.

Click and drag to place multiple conveyors.
[accent]Scroll[] to rotate.
keys.gz.conveyors.mobile:
Research and place :conveyor: [accent]conveyors[] to move the mined resources
from drills to the core.

Hold down your finger for a second and drag to place multiple conveyors.
keys.gz.drills: Expand the mining operation.\nPlace more Mechanical Drills.\nMine 100 copper.
keys.gz.duoammo: Supply the Duo turrets with :copper: [accent]copper[], using conveyors.
keys.gz.finish: Build more turrets, mine more resources,\nand defend against all the waves to [accent]capture the sector[].
keys.gz.lead: :lead: [accent]Lead[] is another commonly used resource.\nSet up drills to mine lead.
keys.gz.mine: Move near the :ore-copper: [accent]copper ore[] on the ground and click to begin mining.
keys.gz.mine.mobile: Move near the :ore-copper: [accent]copper ore[] on the ground and tap it to begin mining.
keys.gz.research: Open the :tree: tech tree.\nResearch the :mechanical-drill: [accent]Mechanical Drill[], then select it from the :production: menu in the bottom right.\nClick on a copper patch to place it.
keys.gz.research.mobile:
Open the :tree: tech tree.
Research the :mechanical-drill: [accent]Mechanical Drill[], then select it from the :production: menu in the bottom right.
Tap on a copper patch to place it.

Press the :ok: [accent]checkmark[] at the bottom right to confirm.
keys.gz.scatterammo: Supply the Scatter turret with :lead: [accent]lead[], using conveyors.
keys.gz.turrets: Research and place 2 :duo: [accent]Duo[] turrets to defend the core.\nDuo turrets require :copper: [accent]ammo[] from conveyors.
keys.gz.walls: [accent]Walls[] can prevent oncoming damage from reaching buildings.\nPlace :copper-wall: [accent]copper walls[] around the turrets.
keys.gz.zone1: This is the enemy drop zone.
keys.gz.zone2: Anything built in the radius is destroyed when a wave starts.
keys.gz.zone3: A wave will begin now.\nGet ready.
keys.hint.blockInfo: View input items and stats of a block by selecting it in the [accent]build menu[], then selecting the [accent][[?][] button at the right.
keys.hint.boost: Hold [accent][[L-Shift][] to fly over obstacles with your current unit.\n\nOnly a few ground units have boosters.
keys.hint.breaking.mobile: Activate the :hammer: [accent]hammer[] in the bottom right and tap to break blocks.\n\nHold down your finger for a second and drag to break in a selection.
keys.hint.cannotUpgrade: A [red]:tree:[] icon over a payload unit indicates that its upgraded version is not researched yet.\n\nUnit upgrades must be researched in the [accent]:tree: tech tree[] before they can be produced in reconstructors.
keys.hint.conveyorPathfind: Hold [accent][[L-Ctrl][] while dragging conveyors to automatically generate a path.
keys.hint.conveyorPathfind.mobile: Enable :diagonal: [accent]diagonal mode[] and drag conveyors to automatically generate a path.
keys.hint.coreIncinerate: After the core is filled to capacity with an item, any extra items of that type it receives will be [accent]incinerated[].
keys.hint.coreUpgrade: Cores can be upgraded by [accent]placing higher-tier cores over them[].\n\nPlace a :core-foundation: [accent]Foundation[] core over the :core-shard: [accent]Shard[] core. Make sure it is free from nearby obstructions.
keys.hint.depositItems: To transfer items, drag from your ship to the core.
keys.hint.derelict: [accent]Derelict[] structures are broken remnants of old bases that no longer function.\n\nThese structures can be [accent]deconstructed[] for resources, or repaired.
keys.hint.desktopPause: Press [accent][[Space][] to pause and unpause the game.
keys.hint.factoryControl: To set a unit factory's [accent]output destination[], click a factory block while in command mode, then right-click a location.\nUnits produced by it will automatically move there.
keys.hint.factoryControl.mobile: To set a unit factory's [accent]output destination[], tap a factory block while in command mode, then tap a location.\nUnits produced by it will automatically move there.
keys.hint.guardian: [accent]Guardian[] units are armored. Weak ammo such as [accent]Copper[] and [accent]Lead[] is [scarlet]not effective[].\n\nUse higher tier turrets or :graphite: [accent]Graphite[] :duo:Duo/:salvo:Salvo ammunition to take Guardians down.
keys.hint.launch: Once enough resources are collected, you can [accent]Launch[] to the next sector by opening the :map: [accent]Map[] in the bottom right, and panning over to the new location.
keys.hint.launch.mobile: Once enough resources are collected, you can [accent]Launch[] by selecting nearby sectors from the :map: [accent]Map[] in the :menu: [accent]Menu[].
keys.hint.payloadDrop.mobile: [accent]Tap and hold[] an empty location to drop a payload there.
keys.hint.payloadPickup: Press [accent][[[] to pick up small blocks or units.
keys.hint.payloadPickup.mobile: [accent]Tap and hold[] a small block or unit to pick it up.
keys.hint.presetDifficulty: This sector has a [scarlet]high enemy threat level[].\nLaunching to such sectors is [accent]not recommended[] without proper technology and preparation.
keys.hint.presetLaunch: Gray [accent]landing zone sectors[], such as [accent]Frozen Forest[], can be launched to from anywhere. They do not require capture of nearby territory.\n\n[accent]Numbered sectors[], such as this one, are [accent]optional[].
keys.hint.rebuildSelect: Hold [accent][[B][] and drag to select destroyed block plans.\nThis will rebuild them automatically.
keys.hint.rebuildSelect.mobile: Select the :copy: copy button, then tap the :wrench: rebuild button and drag to select destroyed block plans.\nThis will rebuild them automatically.
keys.hint.research: Use the :tree: [accent]Research[] button to research new technology.
keys.hint.research.mobile: Use the :tree: [accent]Research[] button in the :menu: [accent]Menu[] to research new technology.
keys.hint.respawn: To respawn as a ship, press [accent][[V][].
keys.hint.respawn.mobile: You have switched control to a unit/structure. To respawn as a ship, [accent]tap the avatar in the top left.[]
keys.hint.schematicSelect: Hold [accent][[F][] and drag to select blocks to copy and paste.\n\n[accent][[Middle Click][] to copy a single block type.
keys.hint.serpuloCoreZone: Additional :core-shard: [accent]Cores[] may be constructed on :core-zone: [accent]Core Zone[] tiles.
keys.hint.unitControl: Hold [accent][[L-ctrl][] and [accent]click[] to manually control friendly units or turrets.
keys.hint.unitControl.mobile: [accent][[Double-tap][] to manually control friendly units or turrets.
keys.hint.unitSelectControl: To control units, enter [accent]command mode[] by holding [accent]L-shift.[]\nWhile in command mode, click and drag to select units. [accent]Right-click[] a location or target to command units there.
keys.hint.unitSelectControl.mobile: To control units, enter [accent]command mode[] by pressing the [accent]command[] button in the bottom left.\nWhile in command mode, long-press and drag to select units. Tap a location or target to command units there.
keys.hint.waveFire: [accent]Wave[] turrets with water as ammunition will automatically put out nearby fires.
keys.host.info:
The [accent]host[] button hosts a server on the specified port.
Anybody on the same [lightgray]wifi or local network[] should be able to see your server in their server list.

If you want people to be able to connect from anywhere by IP, [accent]port forwarding[] is required.

[lightgray]Note: If someone is experiencing trouble connecting to your LAN game, make sure you have allowed Mindustry access to your local network in your firewall settings. Note that public networks sometimes do not allow server discovery.

keys.laccess.boosting: Whether a unit is currently boosting or flying over terrain.
keys.laccess.breaking: Building a unit is currently deconstructing, or null.
keys.laccess.buffersize: For messages: Length of the contents.\nFor displays: Number of unprocessed graphics commands.
keys.laccess.building: Building a unit is currently constructing, or null.
keys.laccess.buildx: X tile coordinate a unit is building at, or -1 if not building.
keys.laccess.buildy: Y tile coordinate a unit is building at, or -1 if not building.

keys.laccess.bullettime: Time a bullet has existed, in ticks.

Returns:
[accent]@ctrlProcessor[] if unit controller is processor
[accent]@ctrlPlayer[] if unit/building controller is player
[accent]@ctrlCommand[] if unit controller is a player command
Otherwise, 0.
keys.laccess.controller: Unit controller. If processor controlled, returns processor.\nOtherwise, returns the unit itself.
keys.laccess.currentammotype: Current ammo item/liquid of a turret.
keys.laccess.dead: Whether a unit/building is dead or no longer valid.
keys.laccess.displayheight: Height of a display block in pixels.
keys.laccess.displaywidth: Width of a display block in pixels.
keys.laccess.efficiency: Operating efficiency of a building, where 1 is nominal.
keys.laccess.firstitem: First item contained, or null if empty.
keys.laccess.flag: Numeric flag value stored on a unit.
keys.laccess.flying: Whether a unit is currently airborne.
keys.laccess.heat: Current heat of a turret that consumes heat, 0 to 1.
keys.laccess.id: ID of a unit/block/item/liquid.\nThis is the inverse of the lookup operation.
keys.laccess.itemcapacity: Maximum number of items this building can hold.
keys.laccess.label.name: name
keys.laccess.liquidcapacity: Maximum amount of liquid this building can hold.
keys.laccess.maxhealth: Maximum health.\nFor bullets, the base damage.
keys.laccess.maxunits: Maximum units that a team can have.\nCan only be sensed from cores.
keys.laccess.memorycapacity: Number of cells in a memory block.
keys.laccess.minex: X tile coordinate a unit is mining, or -1 if not mining.
keys.laccess.miney: Y tile coordinate a unit is mining, or -1 if not mining.
keys.laccess.mining: Whether a unit is currently mining.
keys.laccess.name: Name of the player controlling this unit, or null.
keys.laccess.operations: Number of operations performed on the block.\nFor displays, returns the number of drawflush operations.
keys.laccess.payloadcapacity: Maximum combined payload size a unit or building can carry.
keys.laccess.payloadtype: Type of the last payload picked up, or null.
keys.laccess.pingtext: Text of a player's current ping, or null if not pinging.
keys.laccess.pingx: X coordinate a player is pinging, or null if not pinging.
keys.laccess.pingy: Y coordinate a player is pinging, or null if not pinging.
keys.laccess.powercapacity: Maximum amount of power this building can store.
keys.laccess.powernetcapacity: Total power storage capacity of the connected power grid.
keys.laccess.powernetin: Power entering the connected power grid, per second.
keys.laccess.powernetout: Power leaving the connected power grid, per second.
keys.laccess.powernetstored: Total power stored in the connected power grid.
keys.laccess.progress: Action progress, 0 to 1.\nReturns production, turret reload or construction progress.
keys.laccess.range: Range of a unit or turret, in tiles.
keys.laccess.rotation: Facing angle of a unit or turret, in degrees.\nFor most other buildings, the 0 to 3 orientation.
keys.laccess.selectedblock: Block currently selected by the controlling player, or null.
keys.laccess.selectedrotation: Build rotation currently selected by the controlling player, 0 to 3.
keys.laccess.shield: Current shield amount of a unit.
keys.laccess.shooting: Whether a unit or turret is currently shooting.
keys.laccess.shootx: X coordinate a unit or turret is aiming at.
keys.laccess.shooty: Y coordinate a unit or turret is aiming at.
keys.laccess.size: Size of a unit/building or the length of a string.
keys.laccess.speed: Top speed of a unit, in tiles/sec.
keys.laccess.team: Team ID of a unit or building.
keys.laccess.timescale: Time scale multiplier affecting a building, where 1 is normal speed.
keys.laccess.totalpayload: Combined size of all held payloads.
keys.laccess.totalpower: For blocks with a buffered power store, the amount of power stored; for other blocks, buffer fullness from 0 to 1.
keys.laccess.velocityx: X velocity of a unit, in tiles/sec.
keys.laccess.velocityy: Y velocity of a unit, in tiles/sec.
keys.language.restart: Restart your game for the language settings to take effect.
keys.lcategory.io.description: Modify contents of memory blocks and processor buffers.
keys.lenum.ambientlight: Ambient light color. Used when lighting is enabled.
keys.lenum.anglediff: Absolute distance between two angles in degrees.
keys.lenum.approach: Approach a position with a radius.
keys.lenum.attackmode: Determines if gamemode is attack mode.
keys.lenum.autopathfind: Automatically pathfinds to the nearest enemy core or drop point.\nThis is the same as standard wave enemy pathfinding.
keys.lenum.autoscale: Whether to scale marker corresponding to player's zoom level.
keys.lenum.ban: Blocks or units that cannot be placed or built.
keys.lenum.blockhealth: How much health blocks start with.
keys.lenum.colori: Indexed color, used for line and quad markers with index zero being the first color.
keys.lenum.dropzoneradius: Radius around enemy wave drop zones.
keys.lenum.emod: True modulo, result sign comes from the divisor.
keys.lenum.enemycorebuildradius: No-build zone around enemy core radius.
keys.lenum.equal: Equal. Coerces types.\nNon-null objects compared with numbers become 1, otherwise 0.
keys.lenum.flushtext: Flush print buffer's content to marker, if applicable.\nIf fetch is set to true, tries to fetch properties from map locale bundle or game's bundle.
keys.lenum.getblock: Fetch building, floor and block type at coordinates.\nUnit must be in range of the position, otherwise null is returned.
keys.lenum.idle: Don't move, but keep building/mining.\nThe default state.
keys.lenum.itemtake: Take an item from a building.
keys.lenum.maparea: Playable map area. Anything outside the area will not be interactable.
keys.lenum.payenter: Enter/land on the payload block the unit is on.
keys.lenum.paytake: Pick up payload at current location.
keys.lenum.posi: Indexed position, used for line and quad markers with index zero being the first position.
keys.lenum.resupply: Resupply points.\nOnly relevant when [accent]"Unit Ammo"[] is enabled.
keys.lenum.rtsminweight: Minimum "advantage" needed for a squad to attack. Higher -> more cautious.
keys.lenum.shootp: Shoot at a unit/building with velocity prediction.
keys.lenum.solarmultiplier: Multiplies power output of solar panels.
keys.lenum.spawn: Enemy spawn point.\nMay be a core or a position.
keys.lenum.strictequal: Strict equality. Does not coerce types.\nCan be used to check for [accent]null[].
keys.lenum.targetp: Shoot a target with velocity prediction.

keys.locales.info:
Here, you can add locale bundles for specific languages to your map. In locale bundles, each property has a name and a value. These properties can be used by world processors and objectives using their names. They support text formatting (replacing placeholders with actual values).

[cyan]Example property:
[]name: [accent]timer[]
value: [accent]Example timer, time left: {0}[]

[cyan]Usage:
[]Set it as objective's text: [accent]@timer

[]Print it in a world processor:
[accent]localeprint "timer"
format time
[gray](where time is a separately calculated variable)

keys.lst.draw: Add an operation to the drawing buffer.\nDoes not display anything until [accent]Draw Flush[] is used.

keys.lst.fetch: Lookup units, cores, players or buildings by index.\nIndices start at 0 and end at their returned count.
keys.lst.flushmessage:
Display a message on the screen from the text buffer.
If the success result variable is [accent]@wait[],
will wait until the previous message finishes.
Otherwise, outputs whether displaying the message succeeded.
keys.lst.format:
Replace next placeholder in text buffer with a value.
Does not do anything if placeholder pattern is invalid.

Example:

keys.lst.lookup:
Look up an item/liquid/unit/block type by ID.
Total counts of each type can be accessed with:
[accent]@unitCount[] / [accent]@itemCount[] / [accent]@liquidCount[] / [accent]@blockCount[]
For the inverse operation, sense [accent]@id[] of the object.
keys.lst.makemarker: Create a new logic marker in the world.\nAn ID to identify this marker must be provided.\nMarkers currently limited to 20,000 per world.
keys.lst.packcolor: Pack [0, 1] RGBA components into a single number for drawing or rule-setting.
keys.lst.playmusic:
Plays a music track by name, e.g. [accent]"game1"[].
If [accent]interrupt[] is true, the previously playing music will be stopped.
Playing with null music and interrupt set to true will stop the current track.
Note that music from data patches must be prefixed with [accent]dp-[].
keys.lst.playsound: Plays a sound.\nVolume and pan can be a global value, or calculated based on position.
keys.lst.print: Add text to the print buffer.\nDoes not display anything until [accent]Print Flush[] is used.
keys.lst.printchar: Add a UTF-16 character or content icon to the print buffer.\nDoes not display anything until [accent]Print Flush[] is used.
keys.lst.printflush: Flush queued [accent]Print[] operations to a message block.
keys.lst.query:
Queries units/buildings in a specified area.
Results are outputted into [accent]@queries[].
Results can be read from [accent]@queries[] using the [accent]Read[] instruction and an index.
Length of [accent]@queries[] can be sensed using [accent]@size[] as a parameter.

keys.onset.arcfurnace: The arc furnace needs :sand: [accent]sand[] and :graphite: [accent]graphite[] to create :silicon: [accent]silicon[].\n[accent]Power[] is also required.
keys.onset.bore: Research and place a :plasma-bore: [accent]plasma bore[].\nThis automatically mines resources from walls.
keys.onset.commandmode: Hold [accent]shift[] to enter [accent]command mode[].\n[accent]Left-click and drag[] to select units.\n[accent]Right-click[] to order selected units to move or attack.
keys.onset.commandmode.mobile: Press the [accent]command button[] to enter [accent]command mode[].\nHold down a finger, then [accent]drag[] to select units.\n[accent]Tap[] to order selected units to move or attack.
keys.onset.cores: New cores can be placed on [accent]core tiles[].\nNew cores function as forward bases and share a resource inventory with other cores.\nPlace a :core-bastion: core.
keys.onset.detect: The enemy will be able to detect you soon.\nSet up defenses, mining, and production.
keys.onset.ducts: Research and place :duct: [accent]ducts[] to move the mined resources from the plasma bore to the core.\nClick and drag to place multiple ducts.\n[accent]Scroll[] to rotate.
keys.onset.ducts.mobile: Research and place :duct: [accent]ducts[] to move the mined resources from the plasma bore to the core.\n\nHold down your finger for a second and drag to place multiple ducts.
keys.onset.fabricator: Use [accent]units[] to explore the map, defend buildings, and attack the enemy. Research and place a :tank-fabricator: [accent]tank fabricator[].
keys.onset.graphite: More complex blocks require :graphite: [accent]graphite[].\nSet up plasma bores to mine graphite.
keys.onset.makeunit: Produce a unit.\nUse the "?" button to see selected factory requirements.
keys.onset.mine: Click to mine :beryllium: [accent]beryllium[] from walls.\n\nUse [accent][[WASD] to move.
keys.onset.moremine: Expand the mining operation.\nPlace more Plasma Bores and use beam nodes and ducts to support them.\nMine 200 beryllium.
keys.onset.power: To [accent]power[] the plasma bore, research and place a :beam-node: [accent]beam node[].\nConnect the turbine condenser to the plasma bore.
keys.onset.research: Open the :tree: tech tree.\nResearch, then place a :turbine-condenser: [accent]turbine condenser[] on the vent.\nThis will generate [accent]power[].
keys.onset.research2: Begin researching [accent]factories[].\nResearch the :cliff-crusher: [accent]cliff crusher[] and :silicon-arc-furnace: [accent]silicon arc furnace[].
keys.onset.turretammo: Supply the turret with [accent]beryllium[] as ammo, using ducts.
keys.onset.turrets: Units are effective, but [accent]turrets[] provide better defensive capabilities if used effectively.\nPlace a :breach: [accent]Breach[] turret.\nTurrets require :beryllium: [accent]ammo[].
keys.onset.walls: [accent]Walls[] can prevent oncoming damage from reaching buildings.\nPlace some :beryllium-wall: [accent]beryllium walls[] around the turret.

keys.sector.aegis.description: This sector contains deposits of tungsten.\nResearch the [accent]Impact Drill[] to mine this resource, and destroy the enemy base in the area.

keys.sector.atlas.description: This sector contains varied terrain and will require a variety of units to attack effectively.\nUpgraded units may also be necessary to get past certain enemy bases detected here.\nResearch the [accent]Electrolyzer[] and the [accent]Tank Refabricator[].
keys.sector.atlas.name: Atlas
keys.sector.atolls.description:
[gray][optional objective][]
Multiple enemy naval bases have been detected at this location.

Utilize Mega payload units to transport ground forces into attack positions. Build naval units to destroy the peripheral outposts.
keys.sector.atolls.name: Atolls
keys.sector.basin.description: Large enemy presence detected in this sector.\nBuild units quickly and capture enemy cores to gain a foothold.
keys.sector.basin.name: Basin
keys.sector.biomassFacility.description:
The origin of spores. This is the facility in which they were researched and initially produced.
Research the technology contained within. Cultivate spores for the production of fuel and plastics.

[lightgray]Upon this facility's demise, the spores were released. Nothing in the local ecosystem could compete with such an invasive organism.
keys.sector.biomassFacility.name: Biomass Synthesis Facility
keys.sector.caldera-erekir.description: The resources detected in this sector are scattered across several islands.\nResearch and deploy drone-based transportation.
keys.sector.caldera-erekir.name: Caldera
keys.sector.coastline.description: Remnants of alloy synthesis technology have been detected at this location.\n\nRepel the enemy attacks, capture this sector, and acquire the technology.
keys.sector.coastline.name: Humid Coastline
keys.sector.crateredBattleground.description: Water has accumulated in this crater, relic of the old wars. Reclaim the area. Collect sand. Smelt metaglass. Pump water to cool turrets and drills.
keys.sector.crateredBattleground.name: Cratered Battleground
keys.sector.crevice.description: The enemy will send fierce attack forces to take out your base in this sector.\nDeveloping [accent]carbide[] and the [accent]Pyrolysis Generator[] may be imperative for survival.
keys.sector.crevice.name: Crevice
keys.sector.crossroads.description: The enemy bases in this sector have been established in varying terrain. Research different units to adapt.\nAdditionally, some bases are protected by shields. Figure out how they are powered.
keys.sector.crossroads.name: Crossroads
keys.sector.desolateRift.description: An extremely dangerous zone. Plentiful resources, but little space. High risk of destruction.\n\nBuild air and ground defenses as soon as possible. Do not be fooled by the infrequent nature of enemy attacks.
keys.sector.desolateRift.name: Desolate Rift
keys.sector.extractionOutpost.description: A remote outpost, constructed by the enemy for the purpose of launching resources to other sectors.\n\nCross-sector transport technology is essential for further conquest. Destroy the base. Research their Launch Pads.
keys.sector.extractionOutpost.name: Extraction Outpost
keys.sector.facility32m.description: This sector contains the moldering remnants of an explosives production facility.\n\nCapture this area. Research the Blast Mixer. Produce Blast Compound for use as turret ammunition.
keys.sector.facility32m.name: Facility 32 M
keys.sector.fallenVessel.name: Fallen Vessel
keys.sector.frontier.description: A small enemy outpost has been detected here.\n\nBuild Mono units in order to harvest resources more effectively. Utilize the Additive Reconstructor to construct stronger units.
keys.sector.frontier.name: Frontier
keys.sector.frozenForest.description: Even here, closer to mountains, the spores have spread. The frigid temperatures cannot contain them forever.\n\nBegin the venture into power. Build combustion generators. Learn to use menders.
keys.sector.frozenForest.name: Frozen Forest
keys.sector.fungalPass.description: A transition area between high mountains and lower, spore-ridden lands. A small enemy reconnaissance base is located here.\n\nUtilize Dagger units. Destroy the enemy outpost.
keys.sector.fungalPass.name: Fungal Pass
keys.sector.geothermalStronghold.name: Geothermal Stronghold
keys.sector.groundZero.description:
The optimal location to begin once more. Low enemy threat. Few resources.

Gather as much lead and copper as possible.
Move on.
keys.sector.groundZero.name: Ground Zero
keys.sector.impact0078.description: Here lie remnants of the interstellar transport vessel that first entered this system.\n\nSalvage as much as possible from the wreckage. Research any intact technology.
keys.sector.impact0078.name: Impact 0078
keys.sector.infestedCanyons.description: Beyond the mountains lies a winding river valley, now covered in layers of spore moss.\n\nHold your ground against the enemy onslaught. Construct naval units. Eliminate all enemy cores.
keys.sector.infestedCanyons.name: Infested Canyons
keys.sector.intersect.description: Scans suggest that this sector will be attacked from multiple sides soon after landing.\nSet up defenses quickly and expand as soon as possible.\n[accent]Mech[] units will be required for the area's rough terrain.
keys.sector.intersect.name: Intersect
keys.sector.karst.description: This sector is rich in resources, but will be attacked by the enemy once a new core lands.\nTake advantage of the resources and research [accent]phase fabric[].
keys.sector.karst.name: Karst
keys.sector.lake.description: This sector's slag lake greatly limits viable units. A hover unit is the only option.\nResearch the [accent]ship fabricator[] and produce an [accent]elude[] unit as soon as possible.
keys.sector.lake.name: Lake
keys.sector.littoralShipyard.description: Located upon the far reaches of the central sea, this naval production facility contains technology for building advanced units.\n\nDestroy this facility, and use its technology to further assist in the completion of the final objective.
keys.sector.littoralShipyard.name: Littoral Shipyard
keys.sector.lockdown: [red]:warning:[accent] Sector currently under attack\n[lightgray]production, research, export and import disabled
keys.sector.marsh.description: This sector has an abundance of arkycite, but has limited vents.\nBuild [accent]Chemical Combustion Chambers[] to generate power.
keys.sector.marsh.name: Marsh
keys.sector.mycelialBastion.description: This fortified complex lies deep within the fungal regions, threatening neighboring sectors with advanced insectoid units.\n\nAssault the complex. Obtain the technology within. Utilize units capable of traversing walls.
keys.sector.mycelialBastion.name: Mycelial Bastion
keys.sector.navalFortress.description: The enemy has established a base on a remote, naturally-fortified island. Destroy this outpost. Acquire their advanced naval craft technology, and research it.
keys.sector.navalFortress.name: Naval Fortress
keys.sector.noswitch: You may not switch sectors while an existing sector is under attack.\n\nSector: [accent]{0}[] on [accent]{1}[]
keys.sector.noswitch.title: Unable to Switch Sectors
keys.sector.nuclearComplex.description:
A former facility for the production and processing of thorium, reduced to ruins.
Research the Thorium Reactor, and utilize it for advanced power generation.

The enemy is present here in great numbers, constantly scouting for attackers.
keys.sector.nuclearComplex.name: Nuclear Production Complex
keys.sector.onset.description: Commence the conquest of Erekir. Gather resources, produce units, and begin researching technology.
keys.sector.onset.name: The Onset
keys.sector.origin.description: The final sector with a significant enemy presence.\nNo probable research opportunities remain - focus solely on destroying all enemy cores.
keys.sector.origin.name: Origin
keys.sector.overgrowth.description: This area is overgrown, closer to the origin of the spores.\n\nThe enemy has established an outpost here. Build Mace units. Destroy it.
keys.sector.overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
keys.sector.peaks.description: The mountainous terrain in this sector make most units useless. Flying units will be required.\nBe aware of enemy anti-air installations. It may be possible to disable some of these installations by targeting their supporting buildings.
keys.sector.peaks.name: Peaks
keys.sector.perilousHarbor.description: Multiple enemy bases have been established across this treacherous coastal region.\n\nConstruct naval units, and crush their fortifications.
keys.sector.perilousHarbor.name: Perilous Harbor
keys.sector.planetaryTerminal.description:
The final objective.

This coastal base contains a structure capable of launching Cores to local planets. It is extremely well guarded.

Produce naval units. Eliminate the enemy as quickly as possible. Research the launch structure.
keys.sector.planetaryTerminal.name: Planetary Launch Terminal
keys.sector.ravine.description: An important transportation route for the enemy. No cores detected in the sector, but expect a variety of enemy forces.\nProduce [accent]surge alloy[]. Construct [accent]Afflict[] turrets.
keys.sector.ravine.name: Ravine
keys.sector.ruinousShores.description: Past the wastes, is the shoreline. Once, this location housed a coastal defense array. Not much of it remains. Only the most basic defense structures have remained unscathed, everything else reduced to scrap.\n\nContinue the expansion outwards. Rediscover the technology.
keys.sector.ruinousShores.name: Ruinous Shores
keys.sector.saltFlats.description: On the outskirts of the desert lie the Salt Flats. Few resources can be found in this location.\n\nThe enemy has erected a resource storage complex here. Eradicate their core. Leave nothing standing.
keys.sector.saltFlats.name: Salt Flats
keys.sector.siege.description: This sector features two parallel canyons that will force a two-pronged attack.\nResearch [accent]cyanogen[] to gain the capability to create even stronger tank units.\nCaution: enemy long-range missiles have been detected. The missiles may be shot down before impact.
keys.sector.siege.name: Siege
keys.sector.split.description: The minimal enemy presence in this sector makes it perfect for testing new transport tech.
keys.sector.split.name: Split
keys.sector.stainedMountains.description:
Further inland lie the mountains, yet untainted by spores.
Extract the abundant titanium in this area. Learn how to use it.

The enemy presence is greater here. Do not give them time to send their strongest units.
keys.sector.stainedMountains.name: Stained Mountains
keys.sector.stronghold.description: The large enemy encampment in this sector guards significant deposits of [accent]thorium[].\nUse it to develop higher tier units and turrets.
keys.sector.stronghold.name: Stronghold
keys.sector.sunkenPier.description:
[gray][optional objective][]
Once an offshore oil platform, this facility has long-since fallen into disrepair.

High amounts of enemy naval units detected. Be prepared for attacks from multiple directions.
keys.sector.sunkenPier.name: Sunken Pier
keys.sector.taintedWoods.description:
[gray][optional objective][]
Rich in oil reserves, this sector contains large masses of fungal growth, making it difficult to traverse.

Utilize its resources to produce Plastanium. Fend off the enemy.
keys.sector.taintedWoods.name: Tainted Woods
keys.sector.tarFields.description:
The outskirts of an oil production zone, between the mountains and desert. One of the few areas with usable tar reserves.
Although abandoned, this area has some dangerous enemy forces nearby. Do not underestimate them.

Research oil processing technology if possible.
keys.sector.tarFields.name: Tar Fields
keys.sector.testingGrounds.description:
[gray][optional objective][]
A crater-riddled desert valley, formerly used as a testing ground for military projects.

Due to lack of water, establishing a presence in this location may pose a challenge. Be prepared for attacks from multiple directions.
keys.sector.testingGrounds.name: Testing Grounds
keys.sector.weatheredChannels.description:
[gray][optional objective][]
This channel system harbors abundant resources. Land your core. Fend off the enemy waves to claim them.

The enemy will take multiple routes to assault your infrastructure. Look for signs of a possible ambush and defend accordingly.
keys.sector.weatheredChannels.name: Weathered Channels
keys.sector.windsweptIslands.description: Further past the shoreline is this remote chain of islands. Records show they once had structures producing Plastanium.\n\nFend off the enemy's naval units. Establish a base on the islands. Research these factories.
keys.sector.windsweptIslands.name: Windswept Islands
